question: Name the scientist who proposed that electrons are embedded in a positive sphere.
solution:
The correct answer is __**J. J Thompson**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **J. J Thompson** proposed that electrons are embedded in a positive sphere.
 
• This model is often referred to as the **plum pudding model** of the atom.
 
• According to this model, the atom is composed of electrons surrounded by a "soup" of positive charge to balance the electrons' negative charges, similar to plums within a pudding.
 
• This theory was proposed in the year **1904**.
 
• It was one of the earliest models to describe the internal structure of atoms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• J. J Thompson is also credited with the discovery of the **electron** in 1897.
 
• His work on the electron led to the development of the field of **atomic physics**.
 
• Thompson's model was later replaced by the **Rutherford model** and then by the **Bohr model** of the atom.
 
• Despite its eventual replacement, Thompson's model was crucial in advancing the understanding of atomic structure at the time.
 
• Thompson was awarded the **Nobel Prize in Physics** in 1906 for his work on the conduction of electricity in gases.
